questions.label: Ranked Wins
questions.prompt: Since 2015, which school has more wins over AP-ranked opponents, and how many?
questions.reveal: Tennessee 18, Vanderbilt 8 (through 2025). Latest: Tennessee: 2024 vs. No. 24 NC State 51–10, 2024 vs. No. 15 Oklahoma 25–15, 2024 vs. No. 7 Alabama 24–17; Vanderbilt: 2025 vs. No. 10 LSU 31–24, 2025 vs. No. 15 Missouri 17–10, 2025 vs. No. 18 Tennessee 45–24.

info.title: What counts as a ranked win?
info.text: A win over a team in the AP Top 25 the week of the game (bowls use the last regular-season poll), regular season and postseason, through 2025.
